poacher-e03-3s.opus: 3 s of the interval signal (the "Lincolnshire
Poacher" tune) of the Lincolnshire Poacher numbers station, ENIGMA E03,
cut from a public domain recording on Wikimedia Commons. Mono, 48 kHz,
Opus at 12 kbps in Ogg with 0.2 s pages: 18 pages, 5248 bytes.

Regenerate:

  curl -o Poacher.ogg \
    https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/4a/Poacher.ogg
  ffmpeg -ss 0.25 -t 3 -i Poacher.ogg -ac 1 -ar 48000 \
    -c:a libopus -b:a 12k -fflags +bitexact -flags:a +bitexact \
    -map_metadata -1 -page_duration 200000 -f ogg poacher-e03-3s.opus
